assessment.basis: NOT REPRODUCED: the available digitization does not establish a source-faithful reproduction of the published fit. Original observations, regression settings and covariance are unavailable; the shared fitted V0 normalization limits independent coefficient recovery. The numerical fits below are diagnostics only. Broad error-bar overlap is not successful reproduction. Comparison uses atomic volume: hcp cell/2 and fcc cell/4. Different phases are compared, not identified. Nine digitized points have large volume errors and share the fitted 78 A^3 normalization; unknown covariance limits coefficient inference. No replacement EOS is promoted from this diagnostic. Original article could not be reopened without institutional access on 2026-09-24; source transcription relies on the existing primary-source audit.
qualifications: Usage recommendation: NOT REPRODUCED: the published fit could not be independently reproduced from the available evidence. Digitized-data refits are diagnostic only; broad error-bar overlap does not establish reproduction. Historical hcp compression only; prefer the separate Dewaele (2021) fcc thermal EOS for fcc argon. Do not extrapolate this BM2 fit beyond 8.5 GPa as a pressure standard.

primary_data_check.finding: The hcp-argon relative-volume observations used for the Birch-Murnaghan fit are published graphically in Figure 3. Nine experimental markers and their asymmetric vertical error bars were digitized. The plotted fitted reference point at P=0 and V/V0=1 was excluded because the paper explicitly states that ambient hcp volume was not measured.

independent_numerical_check.finding: NOT REPRODUCED: the published fit could not be independently reproduced from the available evidence. Digitized-data refits are diagnostic only; broad error-bar overlap does not establish reproduction. Published transcription preserved. Large digitized volume errors admit the source curve, but coefficient identification is weak. Raw-observation residuals do not support the old 60-fold improvement claim from adjusted-coordinate RMSE. A fresh full-text check was blocked by institutional access; this diagnostic uses previously audited source values and stored digitization.

superseded_record_text.notes: NOT REPRODUCED: the published fit could not be independently reproduced from the available evidence. Digitized-data refits are diagnostic only; broad error-bar overlap does not establish reproduction. The publication reports V0=78(3) A^3 and K0=6.5(1.3) GPa; K0_prime is fixed at 4 by BM2. V0 is a fitted reference volume because ambient hcp argon could not be measured directly. Historical hcp-only fit over 1.2-8.5 GPa; not recommended as a general argon pressure standard or for high-pressure extrapolation. The published curve has 0.772 GPa RMS residual on the nine digitized observations. An errors-in-variables diagnostic has about 0.451 GPa RMS at the original observations, versus 0.012 GPa at adjusted coordinates; these metrics must not be compared as equivalent improvements.
